text: Marine forecast: calm winds, good visibility overnight for Baltimore Harbor and Patapsco River
San Pedro Bay anchorage count steady; no unusual queue activity at LA/LB
Photo thread: evening fog rolling into Maasvlakte terminals
DALI (IMO 9697428, 299m, ~10,000 TEU, Singapore flag) showing erratic speed and heading departing Seagirt terminal; vessel appears to have lost propulsion in the Fort McHenry channel
AIS shows DALI drifting off course toward the Francis Scott Key Bridge at ~8.7 kn; track deviating sharply east of channel centerline
Multiple posts: cargo ship's lights visibly flickering on and off as it approaches Key Bridge; horn sounding
DALI position now overlapping Key Bridge pier; AIS speed drops to ~6.8 kn — apparent allision with bridge support
Video appears to show the entire Key Bridge collapsing into the river after the ship hit it; structure gone in seconds
Baltimore first-responder audio circulating: 'bridge is down', reports of vehicles in the water and workers on the span
Gatun Locks daily transit count normal this morning; draft restrictions discussion continues
Reuters: Francis Scott Key Bridge in Baltimore collapses after container ship Dali strikes pier; rescue operation underway, vehicles reported in water
AP: Baltimore mayor calls Key Bridge collapse a 'mass casualty event'; sonar detecting vehicles in ~50ft of water; ship issued mayday moments before impact
Fire officials confirm collapse after ship strike; rescue teams deployed, water temp ~47F; state and federal assets requested
USCG confirms Dali lost propulsion and issued mayday before striking bridge; search and rescue active; shipping channel closed
Ship manager Synergy: all 22 crew members including two pilots accounted for, no injuries aboard; vessel remains stable under bridge wreckage
AIS shows vessel queue forming below Key Bridge: at least 8 ships inbound to Baltimore holding; outbound vessels trapped above bridge in port
MPA: vessel traffic into and out of the Port of Baltimore suspended until further notice; terminals remain open for landside cargo
Bloomberg: Port of Baltimore — top US port for autos and RoRo cargo, major coal exporter — effectively closed; channel blocked by bridge wreckage
Reports: six construction workers who were on the bridge filling potholes remain unaccounted for; two rescued earlier, one critically injured
Governor Moore declares state of emergency; credits Dali's mayday call for allowing bridge closure that prevented further casualties
Reuters: search and rescue continues for six missing construction workers; Maryland officials say 'all souls lost' feared; divers working in cold water
Maersk confirms Dali was on charter, time-chartered from Grace Ocean; omits Baltimore port calls on all services until further notice
US coal futures edge higher; Baltimore is second-largest US coal export hub (~28M tons/yr). Consol Energy, CSX shares slip on export disruption concern
Coast Guard suspends active search and rescue; six missing workers presumed dead; operation transitions to recovery
Normal berth operations overnight at PSA Singapore terminals
AIS shows Baltimore-bound container and RoRo vessels diverting to Norfolk and NY/NJ; anchored queue growing at Chesapeake Bay mouth
AP: divers recover bodies of two of the six missing construction workers from submerged pickup truck; victims identified as immigrants from Mexico and Guatemala
CASA confirms missing workers were immigrant construction workers for Brawner Builders; vigil held, families seek expedited visas for relatives
Marine insurers brace for what could be largest-ever marine claim: early estimates $1-4B including hull, liability, and port business interruption; reinsurers exposed
Automakers rerouting import/export vehicle flows; GM and Ford say impact manageable near-term; Baltimore handled ~850,000 vehicles in 2023, most of any US port
NTSB go-team on scene: voyage data recorder recovered, shows power loss alarms and mayday ~4 minutes before impact; preliminary report in weeks, full probe up to 2 years
Container spot rates to US East Coast stable so far; analysts note Baltimore handles ~1.1M TEU/yr — volume absorbable by Norfolk and NY/NJ, but RoRo/auto and coal flows less fungible
Norfolk International Terminals berth occupancy climbing as ~15 diverted Baltimore vessels arrive; NY/NJ berthing delays beginning to appear on RoRo schedules
Bulkers and one RoRo carrier formerly bound for Baltimore holding off Cape Hatteras awaiting revised discharge orders
Reuters: US Army Corps begins sonar surveys; ~3,000-4,000 tons of steel wreckage in channel; reopening timeline unclear; cranes and salvage barges mobilizing
Unrelated photo post of NY harbor tugs goes mildly viral in shipping twitter
CSX: Baltimore coal terminal access cut by bridge closure; rerouting export coal via Hampton Roads possible but capacity-constrained; weekly US coal carloadings dip
SBA opens disaster loan program for Baltimore-area businesses affected by port closure; ~15,000 direct port jobs and 140,000 linked jobs cited
Heavy-lift crane barges and salvage vessels arriving on scene at Key Bridge; first sections of wreckage marked for cutting
Wind farm service vessel traffic normal in German Bight approaches
Bloomberg: rebuilding the Key Bridge could take years and cost $400M-$2B+; original span took 5 years; Biden administration commits to federal rebuild funding

source_name: US Coast Guard / Key Bridge Response Unified Command
text: Unified Command opens first temporary alternate channel (11-ft draft) on northeast side of main channel for shallow-draft vessels — first passage since collapse
AIS: first workboats and shallow-draft barges transit temporary alternate channel past Key Bridge wreckage; deep-draft shipping still blocked
MPA: two additional temporary channels planned (15-ft and 20-22 ft drafts) to restore limited commercial access; full 50-ft channel clearance remains weeks away
East Coast port congestion metrics steady; analysts estimate $15M/day in port economic activity idled but minimal national supply-chain impact expected
MSC announces Baltimore bookings rerouted via Norfolk/NY with inland surcharge; other carriers issuing congestion-related fees on diverted cargo
AP: salvors plan to refloat and remove Dali once channel sections cleared; 4,000+ tons of debris mapped; FBI opens criminal probe into the collapse
Army Corps sets targets: limited-access channel by end of April, full 700-ft federal navigation channel reopened by end of May
Drewry: Baltimore closure a 'localized disruption'; container market impact modest vs Red Sea rerouting, but RoRo and coal supply chains face sustained friction through Q2
